LightningComponentBundle.description: Time series comparison chart powered by D3.js — plan vs actual, budget vs spend — shaded green where the primary field is above the secondary and red where it's below, with drill-down support.

property.name: soqlQuery
property.label: SOQL Query
property.description: SOQL query to fetch time series data
property.placeholder: SELECT CloseDate, Amount, ExpectedRevenue FROM Opportunity ORDER BY CloseDate

property.name: dateField
property.label: Date Field
property.description: API name of the date/datetime field for X-axis

property.name: primaryField
property.label: Primary Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field for the primary series (e.g. Actual)

property.name: secondaryField
property.label: Secondary Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field for the secondary/baseline series (e.g. Plan)

property.name: dateFormat
property.label: Date Format
property.description: Date format for parsing: ISO (YYYY-MM-DD), US (MM/DD/YYYY), EU (DD/MM/YYYY)

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Drill-Down Object
property.description: Object API name for navigation on point click

property.name: filterField
property.label: Filter Field
property.description: Field to filter by on drill-down (defaults to Date Field)

property.name: recordLimit
property.label: Record Limit
property.description: Maximum records to process. Leave empty for default.

property.name: fetchMode
property.label: Data Source
property.description: How to fetch data: auto (existing priority order), apex (Apex-backed SOQL), or graphql (UI API GraphQL)

propertyType.name: T
propertyType.label: Record Type
propertyType.description: SObject type for the record collection

property.description: API name of the date field
